title: A workdir-written artifact resolves via alias roots and stays discoverable (v9)
notes: GREEN: the manifest probes canonical first then aliases, presence consult reports the declared output present, publish_canonical produces the canonical copy. RED: the consult is off and the artifact is lost to discovery. gate_replay mode: the driver exercises the REAL scheduler/dispatcher/ledger seams inside the sandbox HARNESS_DIR. GREEN env sets SOLAR_GATE_LEDGER=1 (the Lane 3 fix); RED injects SOLAR_GATE_LEDGER=0 (the pre-contract world) and the same expect must fail — proving the scenario discriminates the class, not the plumbing.
